build_mobilenetv2_model: build a MobileNetV2 model with configurable n_class, input_size, and width_mult parameters
build_mobilenetv2_pretrained: build a pretrained MobileNetV2 model by calling mobilenetv2(pretrained=True) to load ImageNet weights
create_invertedresidual_block: create an InvertedResidual block with specified input channels, output channels, stride, and expand ratio
review_mobileNetV2_forward: review the MobileNetV2 forward pass that extracts features then applies global average pooling and classification
summarize_load_url: summarize the load_url function that downloads and caches a model checkpoint from a given URL
